values.note: recreation.gov lists 29 sites (25 single, 4 group) with seven vault toilets; the FS page says 35 sites and the Forest's 2026 sheet 34. Level gravel driveways 'can generally accommodate an RV under the length of 35 feet' (the sheet says 36 ft).

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10327286 ('seven are spaced throughout the 29 campsites') + per-site catalog (25 STANDARD NONELECTRIC, 4 GROUP STANDARD NONELECTRIC) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/deep-lake-campground ('It has 35 sites ... level gravel driveways that can generally accommodate an RV under the length of 35 feet') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Deep Lake CG 10,580 34/36''), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Bring all water. A small non-motorized/electric-motor boat launch at the Deep Lake day-use area.

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10327286 ('A short walk leads to a vault toilet'; 'No potable water is available on site'; 'The nearby Deep Lake Day Use area offers a small boat launch for non-motorized and electric motorized boats') + FS page (Restrooms 'Vault Toilets'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: The Forest's estimated 2026 dates; opening can shift with weather (recreation.gov's first-come fee season runs June 21 - Sept 30).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Deep Lake CG ... 6/23-9/30 ... FCFS'; 'These are estimated opening dates. Opening dates can adjust based on weather') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10327286/rates (First-come, First-served Season 2026-06-21 to 2026-09-30), read 2026-10-28

values.note: No reservations: pay on site with the fee envelopes at the entrance or by Scan & Pay in the recreation.gov app.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 ('Rec.gov or FCFS: FCFS') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10327286 (every catalog site non-reservable; 'Nightly fees may be paid on-site using the fee envelopes at the entrance to the campground or using the Recreation.gov Mobile App's Scan & Pay feature'), read 2026-10-28

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10327286/rates (2026: WalkInSingleSite 6, WalkInDoubleSite 12, WalkInGroupSite 24; same 2027-28) + notice 'Single sites are $6/night' + FS page ('Single Site: $6 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: Eagle-Holy Cross RD, Flat Tops (White River NF); spruce/fir and meadow loops on the east side of 37-acre Deep Lake at ~10,500 ft, ~29 mi up gravel Coffee Pot Rd (FSR 600) from the Dotsero exit - the last 30 mi unpaved. recreation.gov: FSR 600 is passable to passenger 2WD vehicles but has slow rocky sections, and when wet parts of it may be impassable even to 4WD. --Claude
summary: Deep Lake IS on the White River NF campground list and the 2026 operating-dates sheet (unlike Coffee Pot Spring). FS page + sheet + recreation.gov first-come listing: changed booking reservable true -> false (FCFS, fee envelopes or Scan & Pay), confirmed $6 (2026), vault toilets, no water, 29 sites (FS says 35, sheet 34), added RV max 35 ft and season 6/23-9/30. Pin is ~660 m SW of the main loops (see flags). FS page claims lake views against the stored 'not waterfront' (flagged). Note corrected and trimmed.
flags: Booking: the old note and the derived booking said 'Reservable online'; the Forest's 2026 sheet says FCFS and the recreation.gov listing the FS page links to is first-come only (Scan & Pay). Changed to reservable false / fcfs always.

WATERFRONT re-audit lead (contrary agency claim): the FS page says the campground 'is on the east side of 37 acre Deep Lake ... has nice views of Deep Lake'; recreation.gov says it is 'Nestled against Deep Lake'. Stored 'not waterfront'. Imagery: the main loops sit on the open east shore, the westernmost loop road ~30-60 m from the water with a thin willow/spruce fringe; sites could earn lakeview or better. Not changed here.

Pin ~660 m off: stored 39.76956,-107.30204 (= the FS page's coordinates) is the small loop at the FSR 600.3E entrance, ~330 m south of the lake through forest; the main loops centre near 39.7722,-107.2943 on the east shore (imagery; RIDB has no per-site coordinates).

Road (not a CRITERIA flag): recreation.gov 'While FSR 600 is passable to passenger 2WD vehicles, drivers should be prepared for slow rocky sections and changing conditions. When wet, portions of FSR 600 may be impassable, even to 4WD vehicles.' The 'many roads in the area require high-clearance four-wheel drive' line is about other roads ('While the road to the campground is a graded gravel road'). No current road alert for FSR 600.
Website: stored link is the White River NF home page; the campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/whiteriver/recreation/deep-lake-campground.
Missing phone: Eagle-Holy Cross Ranger District, 970-827-5715 (FS page; recreation.gov gives the same number).
